setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 sends to a MIDI device and plays pattern 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in the default C major scale, with Rate /1. Its Clock page is set to Shuffle with Feel Smooth, Basis 9 and Amount 1. Timing is counted in pulses: each step is 24 pulses, so at Amount 1 the notes sit almost exactly on the straight grid, at 0, 24, 48 and 72. First compare Amount 0, 50 and 100 with Smooth Feel and Basis 9 unchanged. The last three checkpoints are an optional stronger-groove extension using Basis 6.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Select Amount and turn E3 to 50, then tap Play (1,8). Two of the four notes in each group have moved: the second now lands at 26 pulses instead of 24 and the fourth at 71 instead of 72. Compare the ms offsets in the MIDI strip with the straight grid.
steps.title: Set shuffle amount to 50

steps.caption: Set Amount to 0 and tap Play: shuffle is off and the notes are back on the straight grid at 0, 24, 48, 72 pulses.
steps.title: Set shuffle amount to 0

steps.caption: Set Amount to 100 and tap Play: the fullest shuffle for this feel and basis, with the notes at 0, 26, 48, 69 pulses: the second note is 2 pulses late and the fourth 3 early. The second note was already at 26 at Amount 50 because offsets are whole pulses, so the extra Amount shows in the fourth note (71, then 69). For a stronger groove change Basis; the next steps use Basis 6.
steps.title: Set shuffle amount to 100

steps.caption: Select Basis and turn E3 to 6, then set Amount to 0 and tap Play. Amount 0 is straight timing whatever the basis: the notes sit on the grid at 0, 24, 48 and 72 pulses.
steps.title: Basis 6 at Amount 0

steps.caption: Set Amount to 50 and tap Play. Basis 6 moves the notes further than Basis 9 did: the second note lands at 28 pulses and the fourth at 68, halfway to the full groove.
steps.title: Basis 6 at Amount 50

steps.caption: Set Amount to 100 and tap Play. The second note is now 8 pulses late, at 32, and the fourth 8 early, at 64: two thirds of the way through each pair. Compare the ms offsets in the MIDI strip with the straight grid, where Basis 9 at Amount 100 moved the notes only 2 or 3 pulses.
steps.title: Basis 6 at Amount 100
